messages:
sam: Heads-up: planned blue->green shift for router-edge tonight 03:00-04:00 UTC. Objective: replace v3.5.0 (blue) with v3.6.0 (green) using staged shadow->canary->ramp pattern. ack? :hourglass: 
rita: ack. prefer shadowing real traffic for 15m first, then 2% canary for 15m, then 15% for 10m, then 50% if stable. We'll gate on error_rate and upstream latency.
tosh: ops will monitor connection-drain stats and backend queue depth. I'll set drain_timeout=90s on blue before demoting. @ops-oncall please watch for long-lived streams.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by sam: service=router-edge image=router:v3.6.0 pool=green replicas=10 start_ts=3623456789
release-bot: release notes: https://confluence/releases/router-3.6.0 - includes sticky-session fix, improved kv-prefetch, healthcheck tuning
sam: important: we'll enable session stickiness on green using header affinity X-Session-ID (no cookie change). That avoids cookie churn on clients.
rita: runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bluegreen-shift. Canary failure conditions: p95 > 700ms OR 5xx > 0.4% over a 4m sliding window OR error_budget burn > 20% over 10m. Auto-rollback enabled.
tosh: will pre-warm LRU caches with `infractl warm --service router-edge --keys recent-queries` and populate route table snapshots. Doing now.
ops-oncall: alert rules added: name=rg-canary-p95 expr=p95(edge_latency) > 700 for 4m; name=rg-canary-5xx expr=increase(rate(http_5xx[5m]), 1m) > 0.004
deploy-bot: green pool healthchecks passing (10/10). logs: https://deploys/3623456789/logs
sam: starting shadowing now (100% shadow to green, 0% weight). This sends copies for telemetry only. Watch for new errors in shadow logs.
rita: saw a few 504s in shadow logs from upstream-db at 03:06 (4 events). Might be transient. sample: `2026-03-21T03:06:12Z router v3.6.0 upstream=upstream-db timeout=5012ms status=504`
tosh: ack, investigating backend pool. I've raised connection max and restarted one db replica.
deploy-bot: shadow telemetry shows error_rate_green_shadow=0.06% vs blue_baseline=0.03% 
sam: that's within our tolerances for shadow (we expect small noise). Proceeding to 2% canary in 5m.
release-bot: pinning runtime: `infra-api pin --service router-edge --version v3.6.0 --cohort canary` (for audit)
deploy-bot: weight-change: router-edge green=2% (actor=rita) ts=3623456810
rita: quick smoke: `curl -s -D - https://edge/health | head -n 20` returns HTTP/2 200 and `x-upstream=green` on sample hits.
ops-oncall: metrics at 2%: p95=210ms, 5xx=0.05%, error_budget_burn=2% 
sam: ramp plan: hold 15m, if stable -> 15% for 10m. If any condition trips -> immediate stepdown to blue and start rollback notes.
tosh: also enabling circuit-breaker on green for slow upstreams: `policy add cb router-edge --threshold 500ms --window 30s`
deploy-bot: weight-change: router-edge green=15% (actor=rita) ts=3623456825
rita: metrics at 15%: p95=730ms, 5xx=0.45% (close to threshold). I'm seeing slow tails. Recommend pause and triage before moving to 50%.
sam: pausing. Do we have correlation with cache miss rate or backend latency?
tosh: looking at kv-miss-rate for green: spike from 4% -> 18% after green hit 10%. That explains added latency due to cold-paths. We kicked warmup but snapshot was partial.
ops-oncall: ops alerts: rg-canary-p95 fired 03:12 UTC.
release-bot: auto-rollback condition met? evaluating...
rita: since p95 > 700 and 5xx close to threshold, I vote rollback to blue to preserve SLOs. Proposing immediate gradual rollback: green->0% over 2m, drain connections on green with drain_timeout=90s.
sam: agree. Execute rollback and record timeline.
deploy-bot: rollback started: set-weight router-edge green=0% blue=100% (initiated=rita) ts=3623456840
ops-oncall: starting drain on green nodes, connections dropping nicely. post-rollback p95=190ms, 5xx=0.03%
release-bot: release notes updated: add note about rollback and KV snapshot gap: https://confluence/releases/router-3.6.0#rollback  (owners: tosh, rita)
rita: action items captured: 1) ensure full KV snapshot prewarm completes and validate via `kvctl validate --service router-edge` 2) add preflight dry-run that simulates 15% load against green 3) increase canary time to 20m next attempt
tosh: also will add metric: `kv_prefill_coverage` and gate canary at >=95% coverage
sam: thanks all. Scheduling postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT. Moving follow-up to #postmortems and assigning owners. Good quick response, saved the window. :white_check_mark:
